تستبدعون (form X)
# تَسْتَبْدِعُونَ (tastabdiʕūna) /tas.tab.di.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْدَعَ (istabdaʕa)
# تُسْتَبْدَعُونَ (tustabdaʕūna) /tus.tab.da.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبْدَعَ (istabdaʕa)
